name: Dishonor Parents
overview: Scripture clearly commands children to honor and obey their parents as an expression of righteousness and obedience to God, promising blessings such as long life for those who do so (Exodus 20:12; Ephesians 6:1; Colossians 3:20). Conversely, dishonoring or showing contempt for one's parents is met with a strong curse, underscoring the seriousness of this offense before God (Deuteronomy 27:16). These passages emphasize that honoring parents is not only a social duty but a spiritual mandate that pleases the Lord.
